items.q: Is the AI band the same as an official IELTS result?
items.a: No. IELTS.ai is not an official test and is not affiliated with the British Council, IDP or Cambridge. The AI band is an estimate based on the public assessment criteria, meant for practice.

items.q: Where do the test texts come from?
items.a: Every mock test is original material written from scratch by our team. Nothing is copied from official Cambridge books.

items.q: Will Speaking and Listening be included?
items.a: Yes. Writing and Reading launch first; Speaking (voice AI conversation) and Listening follow in later phases.

items.q: Can I use it on my phone?
items.a: Absolutely. The platform is mobile-first and can be installed to your home screen as an app.
When Pro launches you'll be able to pay with Click, Payme and international cards.
